annotations.title: Search new laws, regulations and bills

description: New legislation from official publishers in one schema: EU regulations, directives and decisions (EUR-Lex), UK Acts and statutory instruments of all four nations (legislation.gov.uk), US public laws and bill texts with their stage (GovInfo), Australian Acts and legislative instruments (Federal Register of Legislation), Canadian regulations (Canada Gazette Part II). Number, title, date, sectors, official text and PDF links. Newest first. Runs the Apify Actor tacps126/legislation-radar on your Apify account (about $0.003 per law; spend per call is capped at $0.5).

extra_input.description: Advanced: extra Actor input fields, merged over the defaults.

keywords.description: Whole words matched on titles, e.g. ["sanctions", "artificial intelligence"].

max_items.description: Maximum results to return (default 30, max 500). Cost scales with this.

posted_within_days.description: Only laws dated in the last N days.

name: search_legislation

count.description: Number of records the Actor returned.

items.description: The records. Long text fields are shortened to 600 characters.

shown.description: Number of records included in `items` (can be lower than count when the result is long).

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced the result.

truncated.description: True when records were left out to keep the result short; ask for fewer items.

title: Search new laws, regulations and bills
